# LoopLoot

> Pay-as-you-go Claude proxy with built-in web search and cross-session personal memory. No usage limits.

LoopLoot sits between users and Claude (Anthropic's AI model). It routes requests through its own inference layer, removing usage caps, adding real-time web search to every request, and maintaining a persistent personal memory store that follows the user across sessions and interfaces (Claude Code CLI and Claude.ai).

## What it does

- **No usage limits** — users pay per token rather than per month; no daily or monthly cap
- **Built-in web search** — every Claude request can search the web mid-conversation without plugins
- **Cross-session memory** — user background, projects, and preferences are stored and injected into every request automatically
- **Works everywhere** — one API key and one endpoint covers both Claude Code (CLI) and Claude.ai (desktop/web)

## Pricing

Free to sign up. Users top up a EUR-denominated wallet via Stripe. Credits never expire. No subscription or monthly commitment.

## How to connect

Point `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` at `https://api.looploot.com` and use a LoopLoot API key as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Everything else works exactly as before.

## Audience

Developers, founders, researchers, consultants, and anyone who uses Claude heavily and wants uninterrupted access with better context continuity.
